text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Some 141 people feared dead in plane mishap as ADC Airlines says its Boeing 727 from Port Harcourt to Lagos is missing.
- Shell and Chevron Corp emerge strong contenders in bid to handle $260 million project to build pipeline to take gas from Nigeria to West African nations.
- The number of banks bidding for funds at weekly foreign exchange auction rose to 51 this week from 45 last week.
- Government threatens to take back undeveloped plots of land in the federal capital Abuja.
- Distressed African Continental Bank recovers 450 million naira from debtors.
- Rivers state government in southeast warns parents not to allow their children to participate in any demonstrations to mark first anniversary of hanging of minority rights activist Ken Saro-Wiwa.
- Shell Nigeria managing director Brian Anderson says in Cable Network News interview that the company pleaded with Nigerian authorities to spare Saro-Wiwa's life.
